thread:
incident-bot: PAGER — PROD streaming service "tailer" p99 latency > 2.5s over last 5m. paging: @sre-oncall. Severity: SEV-2. Dash: https://dash.redwood/prod/streams?range=5m
maya: on it. I can see p95 ~ 420ms, p99 spiking 2.6-4.3s for last 6m. Streaming dropped chunks and stall markers on svc-tail-01.
leo: noted a config push 10:11 UTC to proxy chunk-coalesce (hash: a1b2c3d). Could be related.
maya: running quick curl check...
```
curl -N -H "Accept: text/event-stream" "https://api.redwood/prod/stream/streamer?id=abc123" | sed -u '1,40p'
```
maya: output shows data bursts then 10-15s silence, then resumed. headers include "X-Proxy-Write: timeout=30s".
devops-bot: infra alert: proxy write_timeout hit 30s on gateway-3, upstream queue depth increased from 12 -> 200 in 5m. pod-tail-01 logs: "E write: broken pipe" around 10:13:08.
sam: looks like client backpressure + proxy timeout. Short-term mitigations: 1) bump proxy write_timeout 30->65s 2) enable polling fallback for 5% of connections 3) enable buffer-less passthrough for tailer route. Any objections?
maya: implementing 1 & 3 now. patching envoy config and rolling to gateway pool with canary.
```
# envoyctl apply
kubectl -n prod rollout restart deploy/gateway
```
maya: canary rolled to 2/20 gateways. observed p99 drop from 3.9s -> 1.1s on those gateways within 90s :thumbsup:
irene: customer-impact please — who is directly affected? need comms asap.
maya: early list: acme-inc (internal streaming product), finly (payments notifications), chatty-app (free-tier streaming). Impact: severe for acme-inc (sustained p99 >3s), intermittent for others. estimated affected connections ~0.7% of global.
product-ops: drafting status page: "We are investigating increased tail latency affecting streaming responses for some customers. Temporary mitigation in progress. No data loss reported."
leo: root-cause hypothesis: the chunk-coalesce change + higher number of slow consumers exposed write_timeout. recommend revert chunk-coalesce flag and add per-connection pacing (reject slow consumers) as long-term fix.
maya: rolling revert now (deploy id: revert-10-11-chunk-coalesce). Revert ack at 10:18 UTC.
devops-bot: created incident INC-2026-0456, link: https://incidents.redwood/INC-2026-0456
maya: handoff to @leo (next oncall) — actions remaining: followup ticket to add slow-consumer detection, increase default write_timeout to 60s, evaluate coalescing change. Owner: leo. Timeline: full mitigation observed by 10:22, monitoring 1h.
leo: taking handoff. will own postmortem and customer followups. please add logs & reproducer to the incident.
sam: note for postmortem: tune alert thresholds: p99 streaming >2s for 5m should page SRE and trigger auto-fallback to polling. Follow-ups: add metric for write_timeout count per gateway.
maya: adding links & sample logs to incident now.
product-ops: comms sent to impacted customers at 10:28 UTC. template: "We're investigating increased latency in streaming responses. Mitigation deployed; we'll follow up with RCA." :email: 
maya: closing live triage but monitoring. handoff complete. /end
